items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: also went to Canada with Earl Hines playing at the Sauveron, you know, with his group.

ctx.x: And then I went in '72 -- also went to Canada with Earl Hines playing at the Sauveron, you know, with his group. And now -- so that's -- now, the rest of the time since '71-'73 -- '71 up until now I've been on the house band at the Garden, play the ice shows, Holiday on Ice, Ice Capades, Moscow Circus and whatever shows and the circus,
whatever comes in there. I don't know what's going to happen now because my contract died a month ago.
